Selector permission applies to every target and all arguments. It is not a target allowlist.

Symbolic adapter histories have length 0 or 2; real composition has one adapter. No proof for arbitrary adapter arrays or classifier changes concurrent with external calls.
Unique stable adapter IDs. Truthful vault allocation/totalAssets and classifier views. Symbolic cases use counts 0,1,2,3 and explicit cap branches.
Products and two-adapter sum overflow have explicit fixtures. Existing allocation plus request overflow has no isolated fixture; finite uint64-domain cap test covers nonoverflow branch.
No classifier cap bound exists. For success domain require each product <= uint256.max and sums <= uint256.max. Do not claim all admin-selected values remain live.
Recording vault proves forwarding only; real Morpho and strategy behavior needs integration fuzz.

Production integration uses actual ERC4626Strategy, VaultV2, allocator and classifier with concrete 1000 assets, standard OpenZeppelin ERC4626 and one strategy. Yield, nonstandard assets, arbitrary adapters and liquidity-adapter deposit bypass remain outside this proof.
Risk checks use requested amount while Morpho updates from adapter-reported change. Liquidity adapter actions happen outside _validateCaps. Neither is covered by a recording-vault proof.
removeStrategy myt argument affects only nonzero validation/event; execution uses stored mapping. No mapping uniqueness invariant is enforced.

Actual VaultV2 addAdapter covers pending, premature rejection, execution and replay. Other timelocked selectors are checked for exact encoding and authority, not each full timelock execution pipeline.
Local curator has no timelock state. Morpho is responsible for all timelock enforcement.
Caps are arbitrary uint256. There is no enforced <=1e18 bound or local<=global bound. Test storage fidelity, not an invented percentage invariant.
Standard token without transfer fee/rebase, or native ETH. Include recipient==vault separately.
Standard token without transfer fee/rebase, or native ETH. Include recipient==vault separately.
Standard one-to-one WETH, transfer false/revert, unwrap failure and guarded callbacks are covered. Arbitrary WETH code or dishonest native transfer accounting is outside assumptions.
WETH withdraw pays exactly one native wei per WETH unit. Direct WETH donation is not included in totalDeposits.
Plain receive remains intentionally unguarded.
Fee-on-transfer token can produce an event amount different from the balance increase. No internal depositor accounting exists.
One callback token tests unauthorized rejection and an intentionally authorized callback withdrawal; arbitrary recursive callback traces and malicious balance reporting are not proven.
There is no nonReentrant guard. Trusted authorized withdrawers can already drain custody. Do not assert universal nonreentrancy.
Use fixed bounded mint history plus explicit counter-boundary storage fixture.
Local suite uses callback spy to prove reset call and rollback. Root owns actual Alchemist allowancesVersion integration; require its result before claiming delegation invalidation.
Concrete bounded minted history. Safe-transfer receiver variants need fixed callback data and separate return/revert branches.
Renderer content correctness is a separate FUZZ obligation.
Fuzz validation uses independent Base64 decoder/JSON parser and expected SVG fragments. It is not a universal symbolic proof or a full XML schema validator.
Nested string/Base64 loops span thousands of bytes. This is not a formal proof over all token IDs.
Atomic proxy deployment and initialization is a deployment assumption. Proxy admin/upgrade machinery is separately scoped.
No global supply cap exists. Limit successful amount to available supply headroom; separately assert overflow revert.
burn(address,uint256) and burnFrom reduce maximum allowance too, unlike ERC20 transferFrom.

uint96 success domain and fixed monotone times; explicit uint256.max readable-cap liveness candidate is kept failing rather than assumed away. Partial-time burn refill is covered through shared production routine but test directly samples only mint partial refill and burn full-day refill.
Monotone realistic time; timestamp+86400 fits. Admin limits need explicit overflow cases because source accepts arbitrary uint256.
maxFlashLoanAmount has no source bound. Restrict normal success amount<=uint256.max/fee and record this limitation.
Receiver fixture covers standard repayment, callback rejection/revert, insufficient fee, and blocked nested loan. Arbitrary borrower action sequences are not covered.
For exact final delta receiver performs no independent mint/burn/transfer beyond repayment fixture. Fee reserve exists before callback.
ADMIN_ROLE is its own administrator. No DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder is assigned during initialize.
Crypto primitives are trusted; signed-message tests run only under Forge. Symbolic tests cover expiry/high-s gates and state rollback.
Crypto unforgeability is an assumption. Halmos ecrecover abstraction cannot prove the cryptographic primitive.
Reentry is tested for a router callback into allocate. Combined malicious-token callbacks and reentry into every other selector lack dedicated sequence tests.
Reentry is tested for a router callback into allocate. Combined malicious-token callbacks and reentry into every other selector lack dedicated sequence tests.
Zero returned mint amounts are tested and rejected. A dependency that returns a positive share amount without minting those shares lacks a dedicated negative test.
Zero returned mint amounts are tested and rejected. A dependency that returns a positive share amount without minting those shares lacks a dedicated negative test.
Reentry is tested for a router callback into allocate. Combined malicious-token callbacks and reentry into every other selector lack dedicated sequence tests.
Reentry is tested for a router callback into allocate. Combined malicious-token callbacks and reentry into every other selector lack dedicated sequence tests.
Unused graphSize and zero syntheticToken characterization are documented in scope but lack distinct assertions.
Successful setAlchemist behavior occurs in the fixture and decimal tests. No arbitrary-address configuration safety assertion exists.
int256.max accepted boundary lacks a distinct positive test. Cap below current active principal is characterized.
Existing-position preservation is checked. The full positive int256 duration range is not successful deposit coverage.
Symbolic timeline fixes start10 and duration4. Time and graph expansion coverage comes from the separate graph harness.
Fuzz amounts cover 1..1e27 and variable durations cover1..2^20 with amounts<=1e24. Only one large signed-product rejection boundary is explicit. Broad endpoint/rate boundary fuzz remains.
Actual claim fuzz includes arbitrary duration1..2^20 and elapsed1..duration+1. Symbolic checks still use duration4. A full-range duration proof is not claimed.
Non-exact/zero backing fuzz uses backing<=2e27 and n<=1e24; concrete decimals0,6,8,12,18 and overflow78 are present. Decimals77/255 and external nonidentity conversion rounding remain.
Exact actual token conservation covers partial, mature, haircut and zero/partial shortfall. Fee monotonicity over a varying base is not a separate assertion.
Mock-backed settlement covers existing MYT below/above required debt. Real Alchemist and VaultV2 composition is assigned to root.

Synthetic transferFrom tests a cap-bypass candidate. Same-NFT callbacks during MYT transfer, synth burn, Alchemist redeem/reduce/checkpoint assert duplicate rejection. Cross-position and deposit-during-claim callback sequences remain.
Actual wrapper checks normal, canceled, reversed and invalid intervals plus maximum query endpoint. Arbitrary graph histories remain bounded by the dependency fuzz model.

Two-entry new/restricted-reset/expired/replacement and duplicate-ID branches are tested, with atomic mismatched-array and overflowing-weight rejection. Full arbitrary array lengths are not formalized.
Actual candidates cover increased/decreased power on clear, increased power on revote, and stale expired contributions. Arbitrary multi-voter balance histories remain.
Clear/repeat-clear behavior is asserted. Private voter registry non-duplication is not directly checked.
Seeded two-entry and reachable empty lists are checked. Other lengths and expired contributions remain.
Normal forwarding and a WAD individual-cap candidate are present. Multiple positive risk classes, global-cap subtraction and authority composition remain.
Eight two-strategy replacements use a fixed holder balance. Multi-voter, multi-risk, changing-balance and long histories remain.
Symbolic operands use uint64 and divisors uint32. Encoding overflow and denominator-zero witnesses are explicit. Arbitrary valid encoded uint256 inputs remain fuzz gaps.
uint64 inverse checks plus selected overflow/underflow boundaries. Scalar-add encoding overflow and broader valid operand fuzz remain.
uint64 products and uint32 denominators are checked. Full-width simple checked arithmetic domain remains.
Actual 512-bit code short-product path uses uint32 operands, narrower than initially proposed 1e27. Full-product behavior is a separate fuzz oracle.

OpenZeppelin differential oracle covers full-width operands with constructed quotient-fit denominators. This is empirical, not formal equivalence. Broad quotient-overflow cases have concrete witnesses only.
Formal candidates fix ratio0,Q128/2,Q128 and uint128 amount. Full amount/ratio domain has a differential fuzz oracle. Callers must establish ratio<=Q128.

Formal passing candidates fix denominator Q128, plus zero numerator and zero denominator. divQ128(Q128,2Q128) is preserved as a concrete counterexample candidate in the stated library domain. Whether callers ever supply denominator>Q128 requires separate reachability analysis.
Symbolic cases enumerate selected small timelines and signed64 rates. Arbitrary timelines use a bounded 40-block fuzz model.
Actual storage covers signed64, maximum positive signed112 and overflow rejection. Product-field extrema and every negative boundary remain.
Actual bounds include a last-admitted-expiration rejection candidate, valid adjacent full-tree timeline, and duration-wrap candidate. Full arbitrary standalone duration behavior is not proved.
Four add/cancel intervals over 40 blocks. No claim covers unrestricted histories or the full32-bit timeline.
Formal accepted-domain test uses uint128. Fuzz companion covers accepted signed255 range. Full rejected high-bit domain is symbolic.
Formal positive-domain test uses uint128. Fuzz companion covers positive signed255 range. Full negative domain is symbolic.
Selectors0..5 cover transfer/approve/transferFrom/mint/burn/burnFrom. Exact calldata and return modes are asserted. They do not prove arbitrary token honesty.
Selectors0..2 cover transfer/approve/transferFrom. Exact calldata and return modes are asserted. They do not prove arbitrary token honesty.
Duplicate add and singleton remove are local contract tests. Swap-pop multi-entry coverage uses actual Sets dependency.
One successful ABI payload length and lengths0..3 are tested. Arbitrary longer payload forwarding and target reentry remain.
Fuzz reconstructs decimal ID text and line width for all uint256 IDs under fixed safe titles. Exact logo geometry is not independently asserted.
Independent Base64 decoder checks the name and embedded SVG. Arbitrary title escaping and arbitrary supplied SVG JSON remain outside this suite.
Short/unsupported and valid execute/meta modes plus truncated outer ABI are tested. Arbitrary malformed dynamic offsets remain.
Symbolic fixed8-byte source checks endpoints. Fuzz covers constructive slices up to512 bytes. Zero-length slice beyond source currently returns empty and is not asserted to reject.

Six selectors, rejection branches, zero/two action lists and selector-only malformed actions are tested. Empty action lists are accepted, contrary to the broad rejection claim in the original obligation. Arbitrary malformed dynamic offsets remain.
Actual bps guards tested. Whether0x bps represents slippage remains an external ABI-semantic question.
Fuzz covers byte slices and wrong-token mutations of six valid action formats. Arbitrary complete calldata mutation remains.
Assertions cover each local fixture transaction under fixed benign Alchemist configuration. They do not quantify all protocol actions or arbitrary admin replacement.
Standard exact-transfer token fixture. Real Alchemist, VaultV2, position NFT and Transmuter implementations.
Claims, donations and repayments use short real graph histories. Arbitrary interleaving with liquidation remains open.
The real vault loss fixture uses one loss magnitude. Gain, fee accrual and zero-value paths are not exhaustive.
External token mint/burn models supply changes; it is not a bridge implementation proof.
Actual contract round trips and claims. Hostile callback coverage uses the separate router unit fixtures.
Refer to governance production strategy composition. Limited strategies, cap values and transaction histories.
